provenance.method: Hand-written for structcorpus from the published yamlprims specification revision 1.1, sections 4, 5, and 8; each expected value is written out, not computed.

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: Hand-checked boundary goldens under the default profile: Core booleans, nulls and numbers, explicit and non-core tags, key equality and duplicates, merge rejection, aliases, document count, and typed targets. Bound to the revision 1.1 profile; expectations are unchanged from the revision 1.0 recipe because no input in this set is affected by 1.1/E-1 to E-4.
